value.expansion_review: The shared projection macro emits structural Clone and equality, flat Debug, and flat Serde adapters with the original struct name, field order and unknown-field refusal. Its nineteen invocations substitute only public family fields and inherited ActMetadata. The carrier derives expose public placement and attached time only. Golden pre-carrier bytes and both Debug presentations cover every family; complete typed revalidation remains required before binding use. No canonical encoding, identity, operation or accounting boundary is generated.
